patterns.note: Alternating two-column feature sections pairing clean, bulleted technical specifications with high-fidelity macOS window mockups.
Use of an elegant serif font (Spectral) for warm, editorial parenthetical callouts within an otherwise clean, modern sans-serif typographic hierarchy.
A pristine, off-white canvas punctuated by a vibrant, energetic orange accent color used sparingly for key interactive elements, inline highlights, and CTAs.
The site is genuinely static with no scroll-triggered animations, relying entirely on clean static hierarchy, crisp typography, and generous whitespace to guide the user's eye.

technique_notes: To recreate the layout, use a CSS Grid or Flexbox structure with alternating row directions on desktop to create the zig-zag feature pattern, ensuring generous vertical padding between sections to mimic the airy, focused feel.

For the macOS window mockups, apply a subtle border-radius, a very fine light-gray border, and a deep, soft box-shadow to make the screenshots appear natively integrated and floating slightly above the off-white background.

Since the site is static, any interactive elements like the 'Source / Preview' toggle or CTA buttons should use smooth CSS transitions on hover (transitioning background-color and transform over a short duration) to maintain the polished, high-quality utility feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean, highly readable sans-serif body text with moderately sized bold headings and elegant serif accents for editorial contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on window mockups and cards, transitioning to pill-shaped buttons for primary CTAs.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, with generous vertical margins between feature blocks to emphasize a quiet, distraction-free aesthetic.

standout: The site's standout feature is its 'quiet' editorial aesthetic, achieved by pairing highly technical Markdown feature lists with warm, literary serif parentheticals and pristine, soft-shadowed macOS window mockups.
